request.query: What is the current processing fee for a NexaHome Loan?

answer.answer: For loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01, the processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST [1]. GST is 18% [2]. Loans sanctioned before 2026-07-01 keep the fee that applied at sanction; under POL-HL-V3, that fee was 0.35%, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST [1][2].

citations.quote: 3.1 Revised clause 6.2. Processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST.

5.1 Loans covered. The revised processing fee applies only to loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01. Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction, and no refund or adjustment is made.
The earlier terms were 0.35%, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹15,000.
6.1 General. All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally.
6.2 Processing fee. Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.

quality.reference_answer: For loans sanctioned on or after 1 July 2026 the processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned amount, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹10,000, plus 18% GST. This comes from circular CIR-2026-07, which replaced clause 6.2 of POL-HL-V3. Loans sanctioned earlier keep the fee that applied at their sanction.
